goal: Identify, from the photo on the board, which of the four objects on the moving conveyor is the target, pick it up and put it in the basket, and lift the basket (with the target in it) more than 8 cm.
instruction_templates: Lift the basket more than 8 cm, identify the target object on the conveyor according to the image on the board, pick it up, and place it into the basket.
success: target is on the bottom of the basket: (target bbox z_min - basket bbox z_min) is within [-0.01, 0.04] m AND the basket's xy footprint (convex hull of world bbox) fully contains the target's xy footprint AND target bbox z_max < basket bbox z_max AND target bbox z_min > basket bbox z_min - 0.03 (is_A_on_B_bottom with is_A_cover_B(basket, target)).
target's origin z is more than 0.08 m above its origin z at episode start (is_lift, z_threshold=0.08).
evaluation: All listed conditions are checked together, in order, after every action (reward_manager.step runs once per action, after the action's whole control sequence has executed; nothing is checked between actions). They form a single stage: all must be true at the same action boundary (any list inside the conditions means 'at least one of'). Success is declared at the first action boundary where all hold; the episode then ends. No final_check list is used. Otherwise the episode ends as a failure after step_lim actions. Because the target starts on the conveyor surface, the 8 cm lift requirement can only be met while the target is raised, i.e. the basket holding the target is lifted. Nothing penalises touching the other objects.
objects: conveyor: moving belt (category conveyor idx 1, 'Dynamic'), at world (-2.08, 0.175)
photo: the reference board/image of the target (category photo, label_map keyed by 'target' so it shows the target object), static, at conveyor-frame (2.08, -0.55, 0.05)
basket: a graspable basket (category basket_grasp idx 2), 1, x in [1.5,2.0], y in [-0.2,-0.1], z -0.1 (conveyor-frame), beside the belt

target, object1, object2, object3: four distinct objects from {car 9,10; can; correction_tape; figurine; donut; cup 7; glue; noodles; remote 0,1; sachet; toy 1; peeler; yogurt 1}, on the conveyor surface at x in [0.0,0.8], y in [-0.2,-0.05] (conveyor/conveyor/0 plane), yaw up to +-35 deg
scene_dynamics: Yes: the conveyor belt moves the objects during the episode (speed/direction in the conveyor asset; not statically determinable).
needs_memory_or_language: Yes (visual): read the photo on the board to choose the target among 4 conveyor objects. The target identity is not in the text instruction.
physics_kind: mixed: rigid objects on a dynamic conveyor
notes: The instruction's 'lift the basket more than 8 cm' is not an independent check; it is implied by the target lift condition (target must be >0.08 m above its start while inside the basket). The check is on the current state, so the basket must still be held up (or otherwise supported) at the moment of the test. Basket placement relative to the conveyor frame cannot be mapped to world coordinates statically. Predicate conventions (from func_parser.py): object 'position' = the object's root/origin position in world coordinates (metres, z up); 'bbox' = the 8 corners of the object's local bounding box transformed to world; is_A_in_B = A's origin xy lies inside the convex hull of B's world-projected bbox AND A's origin z > B's bbox z_min; is_axis_up(label, axis, threshold) = angle between (object rotation applied to the local axis) and world +z is < threshold degrees (wrapper default threshold 15 deg); is_axis_aligned = angle between two (optionally functional-point-frame) axes < align_threshold degrees, optionally after projection onto a plane (project_plane='xy' drops z and renormalises); all_robot_back_to_origin() default = for every target (agent-controlled) arm, end-effector pose vs its pose at episode start: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation difference <= 20 deg; is_all_gripper_open(open_threshold) = every target gripper's normalised opening ((val-scale0)/(scale1-scale0)) >= open_threshold (wrapper default 0.6).
